name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on European Union countries to keep supporting Ukraine and to do more. It asks them to send more weapons and money, to keep and expand sanctions on Russia, and to help pay for rebuilding Ukraine. It says any peace talks must include Ukraine and Europe. It also criticises the United States for changing its position and urges Europe to take the lead. This is a statement of political demands, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of requests to European Union governments and the Commission.
- **Who it affects:** Ukraine, Russia, European Union countries and their defence industries.
- **What happens next:** Governments decide whether to act on the requests; the Parliament cannot pass these measures itself.
